name: agentkit
description: Agent-driven GitHub lifecycle: planning, implementation and review skills, agents and guard hooks, plus generic third-party plugins pinned to a commit. Project-specific plugins belong in the project's own .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.

plugins.name: agentkit
plugins.description: Skills, subagents, hooks and commands shared by local Claude Code and the agentkit CI workflows

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Minimal-diff coding mode (MIT, DietrichGebert). SessionStart/SubagentStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks inject text and write local mode files; no network.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Terse-prose mode (Apache-2.0, JuliusBrussee). SessionStart/SubagentStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks run local Node scripts that inject text and write local state; no network. Leaves code, commits and PR text in normal prose.
